# Scott Feltham — scottfeltham.com

> Scott Feltham is an engineering leader (25 years) and the creator of the
> FORGE Framework and Intent-Driven Development (IDD). He is currently a
> Chief Technology Officer running a multi-product production AI platform as
> a one-person engineering organization through agentic AI systems.

## Key facts

- **Intent-Driven Development (IDD)**: a software-development philosophy for
  the AI era, created by Scott Feltham. Founding axiom: "The quality of AI
  output is determined by the quality of the intent you express." Three
  pillars: Intent, Outcome, Accountability.
- **FORGE Framework**: the delivery methodology implementing IDD. Five phases:
  Focus, Orchestrate, Refine, Generate, Evaluate. Tool-, language-, and
  team-agnostic.
- **The working proof**: as CTO, Scott is the sole engineer for a multi-product
  production AI platform — 1,780+ commits and 215+ tagged releases across 20
  repositories in four months, 11 new services shipped, AI cost per unit cut
  3.3× while volume doubled. Trunk-based delivery, infrastructure as code,
  agentic detector/actuator operations.
- **Earlier record**: VP of Engineering (20+ person org: 2× developer
  productivity via AI adoption, 99.9% availability); Senior Technical
  Architect at Builder.ai (Architecture Guild, 8 engineers mentored to
  senior); Head of Engineering at mkodo (0→1 SaaS in 8 months, regulated
  markets); HMRC Tax-Free Childcare (UK government digital service).
- **Book**: "Intent-Driven Development" — forthcoming.
